description: Source code for the BeanStreamPayment class implementing the PaymentModule interface; handles payment transactions such as authorize, capture, refund, and their processing logic with BeanStream integration.

classes.name: BeanStreamPayment
classes.description: Implementation of PaymentModule interface for handling BeanStream payment gateway transactions.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Performs an authorization transaction for a customer.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and capture in one step.

methods.name: sendTransaction
methods.description: Handles the actual sending of transaction data to BeanStream and processes response.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Creates and sends a transaction request based on transaction type.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the response from BeanStream into a Transaction object.

methods.name: formatUrlResponse
methods.description: Decodes BeanStream's URL-encoded response string into a map.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates if the required configuration fields are set for the payment module.
